source: Outcomes confirmed by the commissioner where the written record left them unsettled.
note: Each entry settles a question the emails, polls and board did not. Dated by when it was confirmed, not when it was decided.

entries.proposal: A draft clock of 2 minutes a pick, with one 2-minute timeout per team.
Buy up to 3 extra retainment slots a season at $25 each.
For a tie of three or more teams, seed the top team, then restart the tiebreak for the next seed.
The last-place team organizes the next summer meeting, rotating each year.
The league website moves from the old university address to the GitHub site, https://mspinola.github.io/pdl/.
When the weekly waiver run happens.
entries.evidence: MFL's transaction log puts every waiver run on Thursday between about 9 and 10 am Eastern. The 2008 board post had said Wednesday 11:30 pm.
